name: Hotel Adlon Kempinski Berlin
positioning: Hotel Adlon Kempinski Berlin, a Kempinski hotel by the Brandenburg Gate with a spa, a restaurant kitchen and family programmes
best_for: Travelers who want to stay right by the Brandenburg Gate
Families who want connecting rooms and a children's discovery programme

facts.text: The Brandenburg Gate is 30 seconds from the hotel entrance.
Berlin's main railway station can be reached in three minutes through underground line 5.
The hotel has the 900-square-metre Adlon Spa by Resense.
Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer is led by Chef de Cuisine Jonas Zörner.
Brasserie Quarré on Pariser Platz serves guests throughout the day.
Adlon Brunch is hosted on the last Sunday of every month with live music.
Room service is available around the clock.
Connecting and adjoining rooms are available across multiple room and suite categories upon request, subject to availability.
The Staatsoper Unter den Linden can be reached in 15 minutes on foot.
A Les Clefs d'Or concierge team can arrange private museum tours and pre-booked entry tickets to major attractions.

highlights.text: The Brandenburg Gate is 30 seconds from the hotel entrance.
The hotel has the 900-square-metre Adlon Spa by Resense.
The Adlon Adventurers Pass is a passport that guides children through five interactive discovery stations across the hotel.
Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer is led by Chef de Cuisine Jonas Zörner.
Adlon Afternoon Tea is served from Thursday to Sunday at the Bel Etage.

considerations.text: Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) can be reached by public transport or taxi in about 45 minutes.
Dogs are welcome for a fee of EUR 150 per dog per stay.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
